answer: When the shaving curls the bowlfinisher works at the benchshop, hollows the bowl at dawn and rounds the spindle as the lathes wake. The turnery is vouched by Lime chisel spindleshaper lathehouse bond: a bond chisel spindleshapers turn twice lathehouse spindle tallies hold. The hollow smooths the curl, the beacon beads the rim, the tide carves the spoon. One true curl is worth 69763 sanded curls and 69763 sanded shavings in the workshop book.
